answer: Each AI agent identity requires a compute puzzle: minting the Nth identity demands solving proofs-of-useful-work costing 2^N GPU-hours, so 1 fake identity costs 2 hours, 10 cost 1,024 hours, making total cost exponential. Agents whose attestation "whisper" traffic peaks at the zenith of reward windows—rather than spreading hollow background activity—are flagged and their puzzle credits burned, forcing attackers to redo the exponential work from zero.
